steps.name: Frustrated Police
steps.text: Don't just stand there! These scoundrels aren't half as well-behaved as the suspect!

steps.name: Tired Police
steps.text: ...I'm tired.

steps.name: Frustrated Police
steps.text: You think I'm not?

steps.name: Tired Police
steps.text: I mean, I really am tired.

steps.name: Tired Police
steps.text: We and a whole bunch of scum couldn't catch one bloody woman. Kuso. Kuso.

spans.text: We and a whole bunch of scum couldn't catch one bloody woman.

steps.name: Tired Police
steps.text: She wouldn't touch a hair on our heads. The real scum are the ones she knocked out with her sheath, all of them have a rap sheet ten thousand ri long.

spans.text: She wouldn't touch a hair on our heads. The real scum are the ones she knocked out with her sheath, all of them have a rap sheet ten thousand

steps.name: Tired Police
steps.text: And we're working with these scum against her, while she knocks them out one-by-one...

steps.name: Tired Police
steps.text: Kuso... Kuso!

steps.name: Tired Police
steps.text: Koretou keeps saying, 'it'll get better', but I've been on the job for almost ten years, and I don't see things improving one bit—

steps.name: Savage Ninja
steps.text: Out of the way, cop!

steps.name: Frustrated Police
steps.text: Shougo!

steps.name: Frustrated Police
steps.text: How dare you attack a police!

steps.name: Savage Ninja
steps.text: I told you to get out of the way—

steps.name: Frustrated Police
steps.text: Why you—
They stare into each other's eyes.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Excuse me, officer. May I pass?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Or, I could commit assault on an officer of the law. Or murder. I'm not picky at the moment.
The officer sighs and stands aside, putting his empty hands where Hoshiguma can see them.

steps.name: Frustrated Police
steps.text: Thanks. For Shougo.

steps.name: Repeating Broadcast
steps.text: Ding, dong, ding, Lingones Department Store♪

steps.name: Repeating Broadcast
steps.text: Everything you want, you'll find it here, Lingones Department Store♪

steps.name: Eager Staff
steps.text: Come in, have a pint! We have just the right lager for an Oni like you—

steps.name: Eager Staff
steps.text: Or, if you prefer the more traditional stuff, we have a fine collection of imo shochu for you to pick from...

steps.name: Fashionable Man
steps.text: Take this, ojou-san.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Out of the way.

steps.name: Fashionable Man
steps.text: What's the hurry? Are you looking for the most precious thing on Terra, the stepping stone to 'happiness'—

steps.name: Fashionable Man
steps.text: Wait... you're the Ao-Oni of Kinsekikai?

steps.name: Fashionable Man
steps.text: May I ask where Momoka-san is?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Are you a fan? Or are you after Mifune's bounty?

steps.name: Fashionable Man
steps.text: Neither. I just want to ask a favor.

steps.name: Fashionable Man
steps.text: Can I ask you to 'disappear' me like Momoka-san? Maybe that'll make me go viral like her!

steps.name: Excited Onlooker
steps.text: It's the Ao-Oni!

steps.name: Excited Onlooker
steps.text: Can I get a pic?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Out of the way.

steps.name: Excited Onlooker
steps.text: Wait, Ao-Oni-san—

steps.name: Eager Staff
steps.text: Uh... Ao-Oni-san, we're just a drinking establishment...

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: One Moeshima Black, to go.

steps.name: Eager Staff
steps.text: The Moeshima Black production line shut down a few years ago. May I interest you in the newest offering from the same maker? It's their premium line, which I'm sure you'll be happy with—

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Fine. Whatever.
While the clerk gets the liquor, Hoshiguma stands with her back against the storefront, gazing coldly at the crowd that has begun to gather.
A city is a big place, whether it's called Lungmen or Mitsukue.
The death of one man does not move the heart of the whole city, much less the death of a yakuza figurehead.
One man has died. Many still live.
But the people who still live, this city that they live in, has nothing to do with her anymore.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: No one is following.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: This is a good place.
Hoshiguma opens the bottle, and the smell of alcohol gushes out.
Just smelling it is enough to make her light-headed.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: This one's for you, Uncle Tessai.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Ugh... how could this stuff taste so thin, when it's so expensive and the alcohol content so high?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: This is the second time I've drank to someone. The first was to my father at my old home.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: The kaidan chasers must be thrilled about the Ao-Oni drinking with a dead man.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Kaidan... hah.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: The story of me and Higashi ended when I chose to step up for what was right, when I really didn't know what it was.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: It was stupid, even though I survived. Ch'en, too, faced the same choice, and she survived as well, but I still think it's stupid.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: You should have met Ch'en Hui-chieh, Uncle Tessai.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: She's a true kyou, although they pronounce it a different way in Yan. But it refers to the same thing: Someone who's willing to stand in the way of an army a thousand strong, armed with nothing more than a sword.

spans.text: , although they pronounce it a different way in Yan. But it refers to the same thing: Someone who's willing to stand in the way of an army a thousand strong, armed with nothing more than a sword.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: This one's to her.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: But I'm not like her.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: She's brave. Unlike me—

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Hah, awkward, isn't it?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: But I'm scared... I can't deny it.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: I'm not worried about my own life. But what about other people? Those I'm trying to protect? What about...?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: ...What about my home?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Honestly, I should just set out for Lungmen right now, and never look back.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: It's a big deal, an L.G.D. officer suspected of murder in Higashi. That'd make a headache for everybody, from Missy to Mr. Lin to Madam Fumizuki to Mr. Wei.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: They won't abandon me. I know what kind of people they are, and they know me well.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: But I caused this.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Will my new home suffer for the trouble that I caused?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: How could I keep calling it home, in that case?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Or I could draw my sword and become a real Oni. A killer.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Kill Kinbee, kill any of his men who dare draw on me, kill any police who stand in my way...

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Turn into a nightmare that roams the streets of Mitsukue, become a true monster, become the kaidan after all.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Take vengeance. Go with the tide, embrace the times, become the maddest of the revelers, and become exactly what he...

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: No, exactly what everyone in Mitsukue wants me to be.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: There's no way out. Every path leads to a dead end.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Is the bottle empty already?
You certainly can hold your drink, Hoshiguma-san.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Who's there?!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Where are your men?

steps.name: Detective Koretou
steps.text: I came alone.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Where's Uncle Tessai's body?

steps.name: Detective Koretou
steps.text: In police possession. Cause of death was a sword wound, but it was not your sword that did the deed.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Then why are your men after me?

steps.name: Detective Koretou
steps.text: Orders from above.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Are you here to arrest me too?

steps.name: Detective Koretou
steps.text: No, I'm here to drink with you.
Without waiting for an answer, the policeman sits down on the ground and takes out a small glass from his pocket.

steps.name: Detective Koretou
steps.text: Damn, this stuff is strong.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: You want to try to convince me to come quietly, so you can carry out those orders from above?

steps.name: Detective Koretou
steps.text: Then, get you out of Mitsukue and back to Lungmen.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Against the orders of your superiors?

steps.name: Detective Koretou
steps.text: Why do you think I had you taken into custody the moment you entered Mitsukue?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: I would have done the same, if a gang leader who had committed a major crime in Lungmen twenty years ago came back.

steps.name: Detective Koretou
steps.text: Is that all?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: What else could it be?
The policeman looks straight into Hoshiguma's eyes.
When he realizes that Hoshiguma is not joking or hiding anything, he suddenly punches her in the face.

steps.name: Detective Koretou
steps.text: I can't believe you forgot.

steps.name: Detective Koretou
steps.text: The Diet candidate killed by the Kinsekikai was named Koretou.

steps.name: Detective Koretou
steps.text: That was for my uncle.

steps.name: Detective Koretou
steps.text: Kono bakayaro. His murder would not have gone ignored all these years, if you didn't stupidly claim responsibility for your stupid yakuza honor.

spans.text: His murder would not have gone ignored all these years, if you didn't stupidly claim responsibility for your stupid yakuza honor.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Sorry...

steps.name: Detective Koretou
steps.text: It's a little too late for that. There's nothing I can do about Mifune now.

steps.name: Detective Koretou
steps.text: He's in cahoots with one of the most powerful Diet member. How else could a yakuza have gained so much influence over the police?

steps.name: Detective Koretou
steps.text: The best I can do—the best the police can do is to let you go, so he won't get what he wants.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: And Uncle Tessai's death will be nothing more than a footnote in the Ao-Oni kaidan legend and the Haunted House, and nothing will ever get resolved. Same as it was back then, am I right, Detective Koretou of the Spiritual Affairs Station?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: You say you don't want him to get what he wants, but all you're doing is helping him.

steps.name: Detective Koretou
steps.text: You think Mifune is behind the kaidan.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: You don't sound surprised.

steps.name: Detective Koretou
steps.text: A cop is a cop, even if he's from the Spiritual Affairs Station. I can smell where the rot is coming from, even with this chained collar around my neck.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: So you've made peace with the chains?

steps.name: Detective Koretou
steps.text: All you need to worry about is filling your own stomach with fried meatchop with rice. Not all of us are the same.

steps.name: Detective Koretou
steps.text: Do you know how much it costs to get a house that can barely squeeze a family of four in Mitsukue?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: I'm not sure I want to know.

steps.name: Detective Koretou
steps.text: If you're willing to pay off my loans and take my wife and kids to Lungmen, sure, I'll turn your old home upside down.

steps.name: Detective Koretou
steps.text: Or, if you're absolutely certain that it'll be a fatal blow to Mifune, I could potentially see myself jumping on this gamble of yours.

steps.name: Detective Koretou
steps.text: Now, it's your turn to answer.

steps.name: Detective Koretou
steps.text: Do you plan on paying off these loans that I'm not even sure I could free myself of before I die, or is there a greater power than the Diet, enough to take Mifune out once and for all?

steps.name: Detective Koretou
steps.text: I'm doing my best to help you. Recognize good faith when you see it, Ao-Oni.
The policeman angrily downs the last bit of liquor left in the cup.

steps.name: Detective Koretou
steps.text: Come with me.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Detective Koretou
steps.text: Give me a reason.

a.text: I want my sacrifice to mean something, but everything in Mitsukue is denying it.
What else is left for me in this empty city?
I hope Missy had a better summer in Siesta than I did here—

steps.text: ...guma!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Who's there?

steps.name: Detective Koretou
steps.text: Who's what? What are you talking about?
...Hoshiguma!
Ghost-san!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Momoka?!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Do you hear Momoka's voice, Koretou?

steps.name: Detective Koretou
steps.text: Momoka? The idol? Isn't she supposed to be with you? I was going to ask where you hid—

steps.name: Momoka's Voice
steps.text: I'm over here!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: This way!
Hoshiguma runs in the direction of the voice.
Koretou sighs and follows her.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: There's no one here. But the voice is getting closer—

steps.name: Momoka's Voice
steps.text: Over here! This way!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Momoka?!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: What—
...What are you doing in a TV?
Neither Hoshiguma nor Koretou say it out loud.
A shabby TV set lies outside a tiny shop. It is hard to tell what the shop does, or if it is even open at all.
Inside, Momoka is yelling something at Hoshiguma.
She is not looking at Hoshiguma, but knocking on something in front of her, as though she is trying to break the TV screen and climb out.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: You're there, right, Hoshiguma?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: I'm here! Can't you see me?

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: I can't see you, but I can hear you!

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: Oh, I'm so relieved... I thought it was all over...

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Hold the tears. Where are you? What's going on with this TV?

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: Kichisei and I are being held prisoner at Kinbee's base—
Bzzt.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Momoka?!
The TV goes dark.
A cold wind blows through the gaps between the buildings, and Hoshiguma's sword hums in its sheath.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Koretou.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: I was agitated by Uncle Tessai's death and forgot a few things. My bad.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: But what about you? Did you really think I'd hidden Momoka?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Kichisei too. I guess she's not important to you, nothing more than an inveterate pachinko gambler.

steps.name: Detective Koretou
steps.text: Hoshiguma—

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: What's one or two innocent lives to you, as long as you get this troublemaker out of town? After all, they're already knee-deep in this Kinbee mess. Why bother?

steps.name: Detective Koretou
steps.text: We'll do our best to protect them—

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: The people who died in the Haunted House, Uncle Tessai, that yakuza killed in Kajimachi a few days ago... since when have you been any good at protecting anybody?
It is Hoshiguma's turn to punch the detective in the face.
The detective stumbles back a few steps before steadying himself.

steps.name: Detective Koretou
steps.text: I don't need you to remind me of my failures.

steps.name: Detective Koretou
steps.text: But you're not a troublemaker to me. You're my trump card, the only thing that can hurt Mifune, the only thing standing between him and total control of Mitsukue.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: And the way you play it is to get me out of the city?

steps.name: Detective Koretou
steps.text: It's the best a cop can do.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: A cop, eh?

steps.name: Detective Koretou
steps.text: You're a cop too. You know the limitations.

steps.name: Detective Koretou
steps.text: Go back to Lungmen, Hoshiguma. Your 'particular individual' and the L.G.D. will take care of things for you.
Hoshiguma instinctively reaches into her pocket, where her L.G.D. badge is.
But the first thing she feels is something soft, the ribbon that Tessai gave her after removing it from Hannya. A gift from her friends, bearing their best wishes.
For some reason, she feels like she can smell the sea breeze of Siesta.
The haystacks of the Victorian plains.
The aroma of Lungmen's downtown restaurants.
...And the scent of Kajimachi's old wooden houses.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: You're right.

steps.name: Detective Koretou
steps.text: Good, you've seen the light. Now hurry up and—

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: I mean, you're right that the L.G.D. would take care of things for me.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Maybe I've been too cautious... too concerned about bothering my friends.

steps.name: Detective Koretou
steps.text: What do you mean?
Hoshiguma does not answer. She takes the sword and sheath from her belt, and begins wrapping the ribbon around the handle.

steps.name: Detective Koretou
steps.text: You're going to use the sword? For what?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: I have a promise to fulfill.

steps.name: Detective Koretou
steps.text: You're going to rescue them?

steps.name: Detective Koretou
steps.text: Don't be sil—

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Missy would probably be angry enough to burst a few blood vessels if I just went back to Lungmen with my tail between my legs, assuming I had a tail. And I'd never be able to look Lin Yühsia in the eye again.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: As for Ch'en... I still have to fight Chi Xiao with the reforged Hannya. I can't very well go back empty-handed.

steps.name: Detective Koretou
steps.text: Aren't you afraid that you'll regret it for the rest of your life, like twenty years ago?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Uncle Tessai said that Hannya was imbued with the secret art of the temples. But I didn't have the discipline to suppress the madness in my Oni blood.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Discipline, madness... don't you think all that's a little vague?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: I don't know what would've happened twenty years ago if the secret art was there, and I don't care. I don't need it now.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: As long as this ribbon touches my hand, Hoshiguma will never fall to bloodlust.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: As for regrets, the only thing I regret is that I tried to shoulder everything myself, but I was obsessed my sacrifice meaning something.

steps.name: Detective Koretou
steps.text: Why do you think you have to do this? Is it because you're a cop, or because you're yakuza?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Cop? Yakuza?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: None of that matters.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: I promised Momoka, that's all.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Oh, and since I'm going to rescue them, it's more likely than not I'll run into Mifune at some point... and I'll go find him if I don't. There's something I have to ask him.
Hoshiguma sees a light begin to appear from within the policeman's sunken, world-weary eyes.

steps.name: Detective Koretou
steps.text: You'll fight him?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: I'm not looking for a fight, but I'm not sure there's a way out of it.

steps.name: Detective Koretou
steps.text: Put a gash or two in him for me.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: You don't even have to ask.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Is that enough, though?

steps.name: Detective Koretou
steps.text: Like I said, I'm a cop.

steps.name: Detective Koretou
steps.text: I'm going back to the station.

steps.name: Detective Koretou
steps.text: I'll do my best to fend off pressure from upstairs, as long as there are no corpses.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Words cannot express my gratitude.

steps.name: Detective Koretou
steps.text: I hope I live up to it.
